the Studio

our space and backdrops

The photo studio consists of two rooms with plenty of open space for creative work. With a ceiling height of 4+ meters, ideal for overhead shots, and 10 meters of distance from the background, you can take full-body shots even with a 105 mm focal length.

If you arrive early, you can sit down in our reception area and have a coffee on us while you browse some photo books or prepare for your shoot. The studio opens from an enclosed court where smoking is allowed for guests.

Our studio in a nutshell:

  • two rooms (both included in rental)
  • central location, 1 minute from public transport
  • easy to find, entrance from the court, ground floor
  • high ceiling — 4.2m with strong suspension points
  • large shooting distance — 10m from the backdrop
  • spacious rooms — 60m2 shooting area
  • separate model dresser room with make-up desk
  • coffee and drinks are available
  • pet friendly
  • music on high quality sound system with bluetooth
  • shower available for use
  • lots of props, clothes and furniture available for free

Backdrops

We offer a wide range of high-quality color paper backdrops, carefully maintained and frequently replaced to ensure they always look fresh. In addition, we have a selection of textile backdrops and a custom-built backdrop to suit any creative vision.

Want something unique? Ask us to build the perfect set for you and with you — just share your vision, and we’ll bring it to life!

Our paper backdrops are 2.7m wide. On request we can order any color that you wish.
